name: Dottore And The Spy
source:
Infiltrate the Fatui, collect information and keep up your disuguise to be given the chance to return home – to the Academiya in Sumeru.

Expelled and given a chance for redemption, you find yourself on a journey into the dark corridors of the hideout. The further you travel, the more branched the possibilities become. What will you discover? Information about your target that is your free ticket back home? New friends and enemies? Or something entirely different?

[from [url=https://byaku-to-kuro.itch.io/dottore-the-spy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
潛入愚人眾，收集情報，維持偽裝，爭取獲得回家的機會——回到須彌的教令院。

你遭到驅逐，如今得到一次將功補過的機會，深入藏身處的黑暗走廊。走得越遠，可能的道路就越發錯綜複雜。你會發現什麼？足以換來歸鄉資格的目標情報？新的朋友與敵人？還是完全不同的事物？

[摘自[url=https://byaku-to-kuro.itch.io/dottore-the-spy]itch.io[/url]]
